summary: GuiaFlow turns product screenshots into interactive guided tours (highlight, click, text and optional narrated audio), published as a permanent link or embedded on a site. Agents build and publish tours through a hosted MCP server and a REST API, both part of the paid Pro plan.

guiaflow_oauth.label: GuiaFlow OAuth
guiaflow_oauth.setup: The hosted MCP server is OAuth 2.1 protected, with PKCE, dynamic client registration and Client ID Metadata Documents. RFC 9728 metadata: https://app.guiaflow.pro/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp. The MCP client opens the GuiaFlow sign-in page and the user picks the scopes: tours:read, tours:write, publish, ai, analytics:read.

guiaflow_api_key.label: GuiaFlow API key
guiaflow_api_key.setup: In the editor open the account menu and choose API keys: name the key, pick the scopes and an expiry (30, 90 or 365 days). The key starts with gf_live_ and is shown once; revoke it in the same place. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer gf_live_...`. A Pro plan is required (402 otherwise).

surfaces.name: GuiaFlow MCP server
surfaces.notes: Tools: create_tour, list_tours, get_tour, add_step, update_step, reorder_steps, delete_step, upload_media, set_theme, set_lead_capture, set_end_cta, generate_step_text, generate_narration (scope ai), publish, unpublish, get_analytics (scope analytics:read). Stateless Streamable HTTP: answer POST only, no SSE stream.

surfaces.name: GuiaFlow REST API
surfaces.notes: OpenAPI 3.1. Same scopes and auth as the MCP server. Send Idempotency-Key on POST to retry safely.
